title: Boca Regional opens its new patient tower
igCaption:
Boca Regional unveiled a $1.1B patient tower in Palm Beach County. 🏥

Sources: The Palm Beach Post, Healthcare Design Magazine, TAPinto, Sun Sentinel, Wikipedia

#BocaRaton #PalmBeachCounty #SouthFlorida #Healthcare

scenes.text: Boca Regional just unveiled a new patient tower, and it is set to make it Palm Beach County's largest hospital.
The Gloria Drummond Patient Tower is a $1.1 billion project at Boca Raton Regional Hospital. The hospital unveiled it on Monday, October 12, with move-in planned by the end of October.
scenes.caption: The Gloria Drummond Patient Tower is a $1.1B project at Boca Raton Regional Hospital. The hospital unveiled it on Monday, Oct. 12, with move-in planned by the end of October.

scenes.text: Boca Regional has 400 licensed beds, 800 physicians, 2,000 nursing and support staff, and 1,200 volunteers. The new tower adds private rooms and upgraded technology.
scenes.caption: Boca Regional has 400 licensed beds, 800 physicians, 2,000 nursing and support staff, and 1,200 volunteers. The new tower adds private rooms and upgraded technology.

scenes.text: The hospital started after Gloria and Robert Drummond lost their children, Debra and James Randall, in 1962. The Debbie-Rand Memorial Service League raised $3.5 million, and the Miracle on Meadows Road opened in 1967 with 104 beds.
scenes.caption: The hospital started after Gloria and Robert Drummond lost their children, Debra and James Randall, in 1962. The Debbie-Rand Memorial Service League raised $3.5M, and the Miracle on Meadows Road opened in 1967 with 104 beds.

scenes.text: Boca Regional is part of Baptist Health South Florida's network. Baptist Health had 11 hospitals in 2023, across Miami-Dade, Monroe, and Palm Beach counties, plus more than 100 physician practices and outpatient facilities.

scenes.text: The tower adds new space, and the hospital's move-in is planned for late October. Hospitals are full of faces you pass in a hurry and never meet again, and NEAR is for the everyday version of that moment, when you realize who someone was after they’re already gone.
